question: Quit India movement was launched at the ______ session of the All India Congress Committee.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bombay**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Quit India Movement was launched at the **Bombay** session of the All India Congress Committee.
 
• Also known as the **August Movement**, it was initiated on **8th August 1942** during World War II.
